proposition: In the Mafāḥiṣ Ibn Turka takes the subject of lettrism to be the One (al-wāḥid) insofar as it is one, and holds that oneness, unlike existence, cannot be relativized by an opposite, so that number is the fountainhead of the sciences.

mediation.who: Melvin-Koushki, paraphrasing or translating Ibn Turka's own work
